title: Holding ⌘ shows every configured shortcut in the chosen surface material; ⌘⇧A opens Agent Center with the sidebar collapsed
invariants: Every *-pinned and *-held capture shows one centered cheat sheet listing the global, sessions, find, tmux and panes groups with their chords; nothing is clipped and no scrolling is needed, on iPad and iPhone landscape.

liquidGlass-pinned and -held read as refractive glass over the landing page, frosted-* as a blurred translucent panel, solid-* as an opaque panel; liquidGlass-light uses light tokens. Borders are hairlines and glyphs are monochrome in every variant.
Every *-released capture is the landing page with no sheet and no residue.
sheet-log.txt holds a show and a hide for each material hold, and no show for the 0.3 s tap or for the ⌘ hold interrupted by ⇧.

ipad-agents-open shows Agent Center across the full width with the hosts sidebar collapsed and only the reveal control at top left; ipad-agents-closed returns to the landing page with the sidebar shown.
capture_notes: Host-free: the hosts landing page with first-open Nearby Setup and the welcome tour skipped through argument-domain defaults. ⌘ is held with AXe HID (key 227 --duration), which reaches GCKeyboard like a hardware keyboard; pinned captures use the DEBUG TESSERA_SHORTCUT_CHEAT_SHEET_PREVIEW hook; hold captures are simctl screenshots 2.6 s into a 5 s hold and 0.7 s after release. The DEBUG [cheat-sheet] log is the show/hide oracle. Physical Magic Keyboard feel, Stage Manager multi-window and iPadOS 18's own ⌘ overlay remain device checks.

deterministic_precheck.details: ShortcutCheatSheetTests (hold detector, content model, keyboard event fan-out) must pass before this case is captured.
